text:
Type: natural cowhide rug
Use: layering on a floor, beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom, study
Style: modern, rustic, mid-century modern
Materials: natural cowhide with short glossy hair
Colors: deep black, faint dark brown shading
Shape: irregular organic hide outline with curved edges and leg points, flat and thin, medium visual weight
Feel: dramatic, sleek, natural, bold
Goes with: leather, chrome or black metal, white walls, dark wood; modern, industrial or mid-century rooms

product.name: KOLDBY
product.description: The cowhide is naturally durable and will last for many years.
